title: Run the AMD Polaris / pre-RDNA2 failing AGC tests on real hardware

description: Open upstream issues: #9759 (agc_driver_sample_order_recipe_depth_locations fails on RADV Polaris) and #15316 (agc_driver_f32_fma_denormal_mode2 fails on RADV before RDNA2: Mesa splits GLSL Fma).
